description: Starts only the SMIOT application service when the app is inactive and host, MongoDB, and MQTT safety checks pass. It never restarts MongoDB or MQTT.

IncidentId.description: Stable Datadog incident or workflow execution identifier used for deduplication.

DryRun.description: true checks guards without starting the app; false allows one guarded start.

runCommand:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -Eeuo pipefail
incident_id='{{ IncidentId }}'
dry_run='{{ DryRun }}'
emit() { local status="$1" detail="$2" utc; utc="$(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; printf '{"event":"smiot.guarded_recovery","incident_id":"%s","status":"%s","detail":"%s","timestamp":"%s"}\n' "$incident_id" "$status" "$detail" "$utc"; logger -t smiot-guarded-recovery -- "incident_id=$incident_id status=$status detail=$detail" 2>/dev/null || true; }
refuse() { emit refused "$1"; exit 2; }
[[ "$incident_id" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,100}$ ]] || refuse invalid_incident_id
[[ "$dry_run" == true || "$dry_run" == false ]] || refuse invalid_dry_run
command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 || refuse flock_unavailable
install -d -m 0750 /var/lock /var/lib/smiot/recovery
exec 9>/var/lock/smiot-guarded-recovery.lock
flock -n 9 || refuse another_recovery_is_running
incident_key="$(printf '%s' "$incident_id" | sha256sum | awk '{print $1}')"
seen_file="/var/lib/smiot/recovery/$incident_key"
find /var/lib/smiot/recovery -maxdepth 1 -type f -mtime +30 -delete
[[ ! -e "$seen_file" ]] || { emit skipped duplicate_incident; exit 0; }
disk_used="$(df -P / | awk 'NR==2 {gsub(/%/,"",$5); print $5}')"
[[ "$disk_used" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || refuse disk_usage_unavailable
(( disk_used < 85 )) || refuse root_disk_at_or_above_85_percent
systemctl is-active --quiet mongod.service || refuse mongodb_not_active
systemctl is-active --quiet mosquitto.service || refuse mqtt_broker_not_active
if systemctl is-active --quiet smiot.service; then emit skipped app_already_active; exit 0; fi
latest_timestamp_ms() { /opt/smiot/.venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
import os
from dotenv import load_dotenv
load_dotenv('/etc/smiot/app.env')
from pymongo import MongoClient
uri = os.environ['MONGODB_URI']
client = MongoClient(uri, appname='smiot-guarded-recovery-verifier', serverSelectionTimeoutMS=5000)
client.admin.command('ping')
db = client[os.getenv('MONGODB_DATABASE', 'smiot')]
row = db.telemetry.find_one({}, {'timestamp': 1}, sort=[('timestamp', -1)])
if not row or row.get('timestamp') is None:
    print('0')
else:
    print(int(row['timestamp'].timestamp() * 1000))
client.close()
PY
}
baseline_ms="$(latest_timestamp_ms)" || refuse mongodb_readback_failed
[[ "$baseline_ms" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || refuse invalid_telemetry_baseline
if [[ "$dry_run" == true ]]; then emit would_start guards_passed; exit 0; fi
printf '%s\n' "$incident_id" > "$seen_file.tmp"
chmod 0640 "$seen_file.tmp"
mv "$seen_file.tmp" "$seen_file"
if ! systemctl start smiot.service; then emit action_failed systemctl_start_failed; exit 3; fi
app_ready=false
for _ in $(seq 1 30); do if systemctl is-active --quiet smiot.service && curl -fsS --max-time 3 -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8080/login; then app_ready=true; break; fi; sleep 1; done
[[ "$app_ready" == true ]] || { emit verification_failed app_or_login_health_check_failed; exit 4; }
for _ in $(seq 1 18); do
  current_ms="$(latest_timestamp_ms 2>/dev/null || printf '0')"
  if [[ "$current_ms" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && (( current_ms > baseline_ms )); then
    now_ms="$(date +%s%3N)"
    sample_age_ms=$(( now_ms - current_ms ))
    if (( sample_age_ms >= 0 && sample_age_ms <= 180000 )); then emit recovered app_active_http_healthy_mongodb_ping_and_new_fresh_telemetry; exit 0; fi
  fi
  sleep 5
done
emit verification_failed no_new_fresh_mongodb_telemetry_within_90_seconds
exit 5
